facts.fact: bushy eyebrows that converge/meet when he is intense or angry
facts.quote: his eyebrows converged till they almost touched over his nose

facts.fact: kindly, strong-faced old man
facts.quote: this kindly, strong-faced old man

facts.fact: carries and wields a little golden crucifix
facts.quote: held between them his little golden crucifix

facts.fact: holds multiple doctorates (M.D., D.Ph., D.Lit.)
facts.quote: Abraham Van Helsing, M. D., D. Ph., D. Lit., etc., etc.

facts.fact: Dr. Seward's old friend and former teacher, based in Amsterdam
facts.quote: my old friend and master, Professor Van Helsing, of Amsterdam

facts.fact: his own wife is alive but insane ('no wits, all gone'); church law prevents him remarrying, calls himself effectively a bigamist
facts.quote: my poor wife dead to me, but alive by Church’s law, though no wits, all gone

facts.fact: researched Dracula's history through his friend Arminus of Buda-Pesth
facts.quote: the researches of my friend Arminus of Buda-Pesth

facts.fact: devout; falls back on trusting God through the worst horrors
facts.quote: We can only trust the good God.

facts.fact: capable of complete emotional breakdown/sobbing despite his stern reputation
facts.quote: for the first time in my life, I saw Van Helsing break down

facts.fact: possesses surprising physical strength for his age when provoked
facts.quote: dragged him back with a fury of strength which I never thought he could have possessed

facts.fact: performs emergency blood transfusions to save Lucy
facts.quote: Then with swiftness, but with absolute method, Van Helsing performed the operation.

facts.fact: uses garlic flowers as protective wards against vampires
facts.quote: his purpose of using the garlic; the whole of the window-sashes reeked with it

facts.fact: seals a tomb's cracks with a crumbled sacred wafer (Communion host)
facts.quote: he took from his bag a mass of what looked like thin, wafer-like biscuit

facts.fact: plans to behead and stake a vampire's body to give it rest
facts.quote: I shall cut off her head and fill her mouth with garlic, and I shall drive a stake through her body.

facts.fact: speaks broken, foreign-inflected English with unusual word order
facts.quote: I shall precaution take. I shall give hypodermic injection of morphia.

facts.fact: repeated verbal tic of asking rhetorical confirmation ('is it not so?')
facts.quote: We have learned to believe, all of us--is it not so?

facts.fact: holds Mina in the highest, near-reverent regard, calling her one of 'God's women'
facts.quote: She is one of God’s women, fashioned by His own hand to show us men and other women that there is a heaven where we can enter

facts.fact: close mentor/leader to Dr. Seward, whom he addresses as 'friend John'
facts.quote: You are a man, and it is a man we want. You are better than me, better than my friend John.

antiFacts.why: repeatedly described as old ("kindly, strong-faced old man"); Seward calls him his old teacher
never described with a beard; the beard in the text belongs to Dracula in disguise, not Van Helsing
his tools are a knife, a surgical saw, a revolver, garlic, a crucifix, and a sacred wafer; no sword is ever attributed to him
he is Dutch, based in Amsterdam, and speaks broken English throughout
the relationship is reversed: Van Helsing is explicitly Seward's former teacher and elder mentor

facts.fact: works as an assistant schoolmistress before marriage
facts.quote: The life of an assistant schoolmistress is sometimes trying.

facts.fact: full given name is Wilhelmina, used only by Jonathan in moments of deadly earnestness
facts.quote: he has never called me by that name since he asked me to marry him

facts.fact: bears a red scar on her forehead after contact with a sacred wafer, marking her as tainted by the vampire's blood
facts.quote: the red scar on her forehead, of which she was conscious

facts.fact: described as combining a keen, masculine intellect with a woman's tender heart
facts.quote: She has man’s brain--a brain that a man should have were he much gifted--and a woman’s heart.

facts.fact: regarded as an almost saintly, selfless, good woman
facts.quote: She is one of God’s women, fashioned by His own hand

facts.fact: listens to horrifying news bravely and with calmness
facts.quote: she listened bravely and with calmness

facts.fact: diligently practices shorthand and typewriting so she can be useful to Jonathan
facts.quote: I have been practising shorthand very assiduously

facts.fact: transcribes and organizes all the group's diaries and papers into one typed narrative
facts.quote: I shall get my typewriter this very hour and begin transcribing

facts.fact: extracts a solemn promise from the men to kill her if she turns into a vampire
facts.quote: You must promise me, one and all--even you, my beloved husband--that, should the time come, you will kill me.

facts.fact: carries a large-bore revolver on the final expedition against Dracula
facts.quote: even for me a large-bore revolver

facts.fact: diary voice is warm and affectionate toward her caretakers
facts.quote: How good they all are to me. I quite love that dear Dr. Van Helsing.

facts.fact: engaged, then married, to Jonathan Harker; works hard to keep up with his studies
facts.quote: I want to keep up with Jonathan’s studies

facts.fact: lifelong best friend and confidante of Lucy Westenra since childhood
facts.quote: Mina, we have told all our secrets to each other since we were _children_

facts.fact: forms a deep bond of trust and friendship with Van Helsing, who asks to be her friend for life
facts.quote: let us be friends for all our lives

antiFacts.why: golden hair belongs to one of the three vampire women in Jonathan's castle vision, not to Mina; her own hair/eye color is never described

antiFacts.claim: personally fights or stakes a vampire in combat
antiFacts.why: she is deliberately excluded from the final hunt for her safety; the killing is done by the men
contradicted; she is repeatedly described as sweet, trusting, and 'one of God's women'

antiFacts.claim: passive or unhelpful during the vampire hunt
antiFacts.why: contradicted; she actively transcribes evidence, submits to hypnosis to track the Count, and organizes the group's information

antiFacts.claim: already a mother during the main events
antiFacts.why: her son Quincey is born only in the epilogue, after the story's events; Van Helsing notes she is 'not so long married'
